_doc: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/check-visible-punctuation.py (U5, 1.1.1). Each entry exempts Swift literals in `path` that contain `contains` (the whole file when `contains` is absent). Every entry must still match something, otherwise the gate fails, so the list can only shrink. None of these strings is ever shown to a user.
